title: Your elusive creative genius | Elizabeth Gilbert
summary: Elizabeth Gilbert, author of Eat, Pray, Love, reflects on the pressure placed on artists to be geniuses. She proposes the older idea that creative people have a genius that visits them rather than being one.
why: HN people link it in threads about creativity, late bloomers and creative burnout as a humble, relatable take on where inspiration comes from.

quote.text: The idea of a "muse", and "genius" is something that visits you (not something you are).
